name: return_reason_choices
source_sql: SELECT id, sequence, name->>'en_US' AS name FROM return_reason

name: storage_category_rules
source_sql: SELECT id, name, allow_new_product, max_weight, company_id FROM stock_storage_category

name: scrap_reason_tags
source_sql: SELECT id, name->>'en_US' AS name, sequence, color FROM stock_scrap_reason_tag

name: category_tree
source_sql: SELECT id, parent_id, parent_path, name->>'en_US' AS name, removal_strategy_id FROM product_category

name: category_wave_picking_types
source_sql: SELECT product_category_id AS id, stock_picking_type_id FROM product_category_stock_picking_type_rel

name: removal_strategies
source_sql: SELECT id, name->>'en_US' AS name, method->>'en_US' AS method FROM product_removal

name: tags_with_templates
source_sql: SELECT t.id, t.name->>'en_US' AS name, t.sequence, t.color, t.visible_to_customers, r.product_template_id FROM product_tag t LEFT JOIN product_tag_product_template_rel r ON r.product_tag_id = t.id

name: tag_variants
source_sql: SELECT product_tag_id AS id, product_product_id FROM product_tag_product_product_rel

name: documents_by_attachment
source_sql: SELECT id, ir_attachment_id, sequence, active, attached_on_sale FROM product_document

name: base_units
source_sql: SELECT id, name->>'en_US' AS name FROM product_base_unit

name: uom_choices
source_sql: SELECT id, name->>'en_US' AS name, relative_uom_id, active, unece_code FROM uom_uom

name: package_type_catalog
source_sql: SELECT id, name, barcode, package_use, max_weight, company_id FROM stock_package_type

name: package_type_routes
source_sql: SELECT stock_package_type_id AS id, count(*) AS routes FROM stock_package_type_stock_route_rel GROUP BY stock_package_type_id

name: package_type_putaway_rules
source_sql: SELECT stock_package_type_id AS id, count(*) AS rules FROM stock_package_type_stock_putaway_rule_rel GROUP BY stock_package_type_id

name: payment_terms_with_line_count
source_sql: SELECT t.id, t.name->>'en_US' AS name, t.sequence, t.early_discount, (SELECT count(*) FROM account_payment_term_line l WHERE l.payment_id = t.id) AS line_count FROM account_payment_term t

name: incoterm_codes
source_sql: SELECT id, code, name->>'en_US' AS name, active FROM account_incoterms

name: cash_roundings_with_relation_counts
source_sql: SELECT r.id, r.name->>'en_US' AS name, r.rounding, r.strategy, r.rounding_method, (SELECT count(*) FROM account_cash_rounding_res_currency_rel c WHERE c.account_cash_rounding_id = r.id) AS currencies, (SELECT count(*) FROM account_cash_rounding_account_payment_method_line_rel p WHERE p.account_cash_rounding_id = r.id) AS payment_method_lines FROM account_cash_rounding r

name: reports_with_line_column_section_counts
source_sql: SELECT r.id, r.name->>'en_US' AS name, r.sequence, (SELECT count(*) FROM account_report_line l WHERE l.report_id = r.id) AS lines, (SELECT count(*) FROM account_report_column c WHERE c.report_id = r.id) AS columns, (SELECT count(*) FROM account_report_section_rel s WHERE s.main_report_id = r.id) AS sections FROM account_report r

name: report_expressions_by_line
source_sql: SELECT id, report_line_id, label, engine, formula FROM account_report_expression

name: attribute_list
source_sql: SELECT id, sequence, name->>'en_US' AS name, create_variant, display_type, active FROM product_attribute

name: attribute_values_by_attribute
source_sql: SELECT attribute_id, id, sequence, name->>'en_US' AS name, html_color, is_custom, default_extra_price, active FROM product_attribute_value

name: attribute_template_pairs
source_sql: SELECT product_attribute_id, product_template_id FROM product_attribute_product_template_rel

name: account_types_and_tags
source_sql: SELECT a.id, a.account_type, a.reconcile, a.active, a.parent_path, count(t.account_account_tag_id) AS tag_count FROM account_account a LEFT JOIN account_account_account_tag t ON t.account_account_id = a.id GROUP BY a.id

name: account_tags
source_sql: SELECT g.id, g.name->>'en_US' AS name, g.applicability, g.active, count(r.account_tax_repartition_line_id) AS repartition_count FROM account_account_tag g LEFT JOIN account_account_tag_account_tax_repartition_line_rel r ON r.account_account_tag_id = g.id GROUP BY g.id

name: taxes_by_use
source_sql: SELECT t.id, t.name->>'en_US' AS name, t.type_tax_use, t.amount_type, t.amount, t.sequence, t.company_id, t.tax_group_id, count(c.parent_tax) AS child_count FROM account_tax t LEFT JOIN account_tax_filiation_rel c ON c.parent_tax = t.id GROUP BY t.id

name: tax_groups
source_sql: SELECT id, name->>'en_US' AS name, sequence, company_id FROM account_tax_group

name: repartition_lines
source_sql: SELECT id, tax_id, account_id, document_type, repartition_type, factor_percent, sequence FROM account_tax_repartition_line

name: fiscal_positions_with_mappings
source_sql: SELECT p.id, p.name->>'en_US' AS name, p.sequence, p.company_id, p.auto_apply, (SELECT count(*) FROM account_fiscal_position_account_tax_rel r WHERE r.account_fiscal_position_id = p.id) AS tax_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM account_fiscal_position_account m WHERE m.position_id = p.id) AS account_count FROM account_fiscal_position p

name: journals_by_type_with_reconcile_model_count
source_sql: SELECT j.id, j.code, j.type, j.company_id, j.currency_id, j.default_account_id, j.active, j.name->>'en_US' AS name, (SELECT count(*) FROM account_journal_account_reconcile_model_rel r WHERE r.account_journal_id = j.id) AS reconcile_model_count FROM account_journal j

name: dashboard_journals_per_company_and_type
source_sql: SELECT company_id, type, count(*) AS journals, count(*) FILTER (WHERE show_on_dashboard) AS on_dashboard FROM account_journal GROUP BY company_id, type

name: payment_method_lines_per_journal
source_sql: SELECT l.id, l.journal_id, l.payment_method_id, m.code, m.payment_type, l.sequence, l.payment_account_id FROM account_payment_method_line l JOIN account_payment_method m ON m.id = l.payment_method_id

name: reconcile_models_with_line_and_partner_counts
source_sql: SELECT r.id, r.name->>'en_US' AS name, r.rule_type, r.company_id, r.sequence, r.active, (SELECT count(*) FROM account_reconcile_model_line l WHERE l.model_id = r.id) AS line_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM account_reconcile_model_res_partner_rel p WHERE p.account_reconcile_model_id = r.id) AS partner_count FROM account_reconcile_model r

name: reconcile_model_line_taxes
source_sql: SELECT t.account_reconcile_model_line_id, t.account_tax_id, l.model_id FROM account_reconcile_model_line_account_tax_rel t JOIN account_reconcile_model_line l ON l.id = t.account_reconcile_model_line_id
